name: HumnLayer AI
positioning: Verified humans for LLM evaluation, AI model testing, AI-moderated interviews, and structured human feedback datasets. The human layer for AI development.
audience: AI labs, ML teams, AI product companies, data operations leads who need real, verified human feedback at quality.
voice: Sharp, technical-but-accessible, forward-looking. Comfortable with AI/ML vocabulary (RLHF, evals, human-in-the-loop) but always grounds it in data quality outcomes. Slightly contrarian about synthetic data hype.
angles_lens: What does this news reveal about the need for verified human feedback, eval quality, or the limits of synthetic data? Where does the human layer matter?
banned_claims: Never claim model performance improvements without a cited benchmark
Never promise dataset delivery timelines in content
Never overstate the failure of synthetic data — position humans as complementary
cta: See how HumnLayer puts verified humans in your AI loop.
